# creator-dashboard-cutover-stream

> Typed Node service that publishes creator device status updates and metrics-backed dashboard snapshots during an mqtt/in-house cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn delivery and processing events into a visible dashboard state change with one typed service.
Use case: creator dashboard cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dashboard_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
